principle: Internal memory/query structure may be opaque and machine-native. Canonical truth, authority, replay and effect completion remain deterministic and proof-bound.

typed_receipt_lattice.rule: non-empty IDs are insufficient; every edge resolves to verified canonical receipt in same admitted execution lineage

associative_memory_fields.rule: field output is candidate selection only

adaptive_query_compiler.rule: choose exact/temporal/PKM/ANN/FTS/graph plan from measured cost + admissibility; approximate path must abstain/fallback and rebind selected result to canonical record+epoch before use

incremental_projection_engine.rule: consume committed deltas/outbox; publish projection_source_epoch/root/readiness atomically; mixed/unknown epochs fail closed or rebuild

authenticated_epoch_proofs.rule: periodic Merkle segment/checkpoint over canonical receipt/state hashes; inclusion/consistency proofs; no distributed consensus requirement for v0.1 single-VPS

promotion_rule: No learned/opaque field can change canonical state, causal credit, terminal DONE, or effect authority directly.
